name: smwmusic-klaus-klaus-an-der-nordseek-ste
title: Klaus & Klaus - An der Nordseeküste
description:
A "port" of the original song, but using the original SMW Water Theme's samples and (mostly) instrumentation choices.

The song is also known as The Wild Rover, an Irish folk tune, however I instrumented more matching the German song.

Originally made this as a joke (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kaUmIplzM5U), but it might actually be useful for a hack...
